_doc: Shared redaction vectors. Run by tests/test_redaction_vectors.py (Python redactor), pi/test/redaction-vectors.test.mjs, opencode/src/redaction-vectors.test.ts and openclaw/src/redaction-vectors.test.ts against the four redactors, which must agree. 'input' and 'absent' are arrays of parts joined at runtime so no secret-shaped literal sits in this file (push protection scans fixtures). 'absent' fragments must NOT survive redaction, 'present' fragments MUST survive. All values are invented.
